sheets.title: Structural Calculations – Loft & Roof

inputs.Framing notes: 2x10 floor joists @16" o.c., 2x10 rafters @16" o.c., 2x14 ridge beam

results.Approximate number of joists: total length / spacing = 37.833 ft / 1.333 ft ≈ 29 joists
results.Hanger requirement: Specify joist hangers rated ≥ 593 lb (use manufacturer table, e.g., H10/H12/H20 etc)
results.Conclusion: Based on the spans and loads stated, the proposed members satisfy allowable stress and serviceability checks where noted OK. If local snow load exceeds 20 psf roof live, re-check rafters and ridge beam.
checks: fb_req = 1344.0 psi ≤ 875 psi : NG
fv = 64.1 psi ≤ 135 psi : OK
Allowable L/360 = 0.5389 in → NG (Δ = 0.8764 in)
Bearing p = 395.2 psi vs Fc = 625 psi → OK

sheets.notes: Hand-written report split into joist/rafter/ridge-beam entries. Loft joists FAIL bending (1344.0 psi vs 875 psi) and deflection (0.8764 in vs 0.5389 in) as printed, yet conclusion states members satisfy checks. Assumed Fb = 875 psi and E = 1,300,000 psi are not DFL No.2 table values. Drawings show TJI 210 @ 16" O.C. for the loft/ceiling joists, not sawn 2x10. Deflection uses total load (73.33 plf) though labelled live deflection. Bearing uses Fc (parallel) for a perpendicular-to-grain check. Two sections numbered '8.'

results.Support note: Check bearing at posts and design of post/footing for axial + eccentricity separately.

fv = 85 psi ≤ 135 psi: OK
fb = 618.8 psi (≤ 875 psi: OK)

sheets.notes: Ridge beam posts and post footings not designed ("Check bearing at posts and post/footing design separately"). No deflection check for ridge beam.

sheets.title: Structural Calculations – Timber Staircase

inputs.Stringer spacing: 3 stringers equally spaced (tributary width = 14.0 in = 1.1667 ft).

results.Tread check: Assume 2×12 PT tread spanning 14.0 in between stringers. Uniform load = 40 psf × 1.167 ft = 46.667 plf (plus 300 lb point load). Check bending, shear, and deflection – passes for assumed species and grade.
results.Connection Requirements: Top support: Use Simpson LSCZ or LSU hangers rated ≥ 600 lb. Bottom support: Provide 3" min. bearing on concrete or blocking. Treads: Fasten with structural screws or nails per code (3 per stringer per tread). Guards/rails: Design for 200 lb concentrated load at top, 50 plf uniform.
results.Conclusion: Based on the geometry and loads stated, the proposed 3-stringer layout using 2×12 PT members satisfies allowable stress and serviceability checks for the adopted loads and geometry. All checks marked OK meet IBC/OSSC and NDS provisions.
checks: Provided S = 31.64 in³ → OK
f_act = 947.82 psi ≤ 1,210 psi → OK
V_allow = 3,037.5 lb → OK
Bearing stress = 24.34 psi ≤ Fc_perp (typ. 625 psi) → OK

sheets.notes: Stringer design is a hand calc: 14 risers × 7 in = 98 in ≠ 108 in total rise (108/14 = 7.71 in); V_allow = Fv × A omits the 2/3 factor; bearing stress uses the full 1.5 × 11.25 section area; uniform + point moments added using the inclined length. Drawing staircase table lists '14 treads', riser 7", stringers 'Hem-Fir No.1 or LVL 2 nos. 2"x12"' vs calc 13 treads, 3 stringers PT 2×12 No.2 (Fb = 1,210 psi). Cites IBC/OSSC (Oregon) for a California project.

observations: Edition mismatch: drawings cite 2022 CRC/CALGreen (plus 'UBC' and '2019 Green Code' notes); calc cover cites IBC 2018, NDS 2015, SDPWS 2015 and CBC 2019; Tedds sheets use NDS2015 with IBC 2018 cl.1605.3.1; hand calcs cite 'IBC/OSSC' (Oregon).

Placeholder shear wall loads: all 8 walls (W1-W4, LW1-LW4) use identical D = 135 lb/ft, Lf = 60 lb/ft, Lr = 120 lb/ft, W = 135 lbs, Eq = 35 lbs, SDS = 1; e.g. W1 (37.5 ft) Vw_max / Vw = 0.016. No wind/seismic base-shear derivation provided.

Shear walls combine 5/8'' gypsum (Side 1, 0.120'' nails at 4''/7'') with 3/8'' plywood siding (Side 2, 8d casing nails at 4'') taking vsc = vwc = max(2 × min, vs1, vs2) = 800 lb/ft; aspect ratio limit printed as 2 so several W1/LW2 segments are 'not considered'; LW2 prints the DESIGN WARNING (strength distribution, no drift check).

Loft floor joists (2x10 @ 16", span 16.167 ft) FAIL as printed: fb = 1344.0 psi > 875 psi (NG) and Δ = 0.8764 in > L/360 = 0.5389 in (NG), yet the conclusion says members satisfy checks; drawings show TJI 210 @ 16" O.C. instead of sawn 2x10.

Rafter deflection printed inconsistently (0.03 in vs 0.0430 in); drawings show pre-engineered roof trusses @ 24" O.C. while calc designs 2x10 rafters @ 16" and a 2x14 ridge beam on posts @ ~8 ft with no post/footing design.
Staircase: 14 risers × 7 in ≠ 108 in rise; calc uses 13 treads and 3 PT 2×12 No.2 stringers vs drawing table 14 treads and '2 nos. 2"x12"' Hem-Fir No.1 or LVL; V_allow = Fv × A omits 2/3.
Drawings reference a 'SHEAR WALL SCHEDULE' and Simpson HTT holdowns, but no shear wall schedule appears; calc hold-down forces are negative (e.g. W1 T5 = -0.059 kips).
No foundation calculation in the package although lap splice schedule (f'c = 2500 PSI) and holdown/anchor details are shown.
extractionNotes: Values copied verbatim from the text dump (no recalculation). Markdown escape backslashes in the dump were removed (e.g. 'Vw\_max' -> 'Vw_max', 'Fc\*' -> 'Fc*'). Keys are the printed Tedds symbols; where a symbol repeats on a sheet the key carries the printed heading context in [brackets] and '#n' for further repeats. 'labels' maps keys to the printed description. Inputs = plain printed values in input blocks; results = computed values (printed with a formula), ratios, and values printed in analysis/design blocks; results.checks = PASS/FAIL lines as printed.
